hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git push'; then LOG=/tmp/claude-hook-debug.log; echo "--- $(date) ---" >> $LOG; git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG; FETCH_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; git rebase origin/main 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG; REBASE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo "fetch=$FETCH_EXIT rebase=$REBASE_EXIT" >> $LOG; if [ $REBASE_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Auto-rebase onto origin/main failed — resolve conflicts before pushing."}'; exit 1; fi; fi

bd prime && echo '' && echo '=== MORNING REPORT DATA (pre-gathered) ===' && echo '--- In Progress ---' && bd list --status=in_progress 2>/dev/null && echo '--- P0 Critical ---' && bd list --status=open --priority=0 2>/dev/null && echo '--- P1 High ---' && bd list --status=open --priority=1 2>/dev/null && echo '--- Ready (no blockers) ---' && bd ready 2>/dev/null && echo '--- Stale ---' && bd stale 2>/dev/null && echo '--- Recent Git ---' && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null && echo '=== END MORNING REPORT DATA ==='
